thread:
lia: Quick one — local devs keep hitting broken anchor links after the mkdocs migration. saw a flurry of tiny bug reports.

oz: ah that's on me, I missed that mkdocs slugify keeps underscores in headings. The migration script I ran normalized to docusaurus-style slugs.

link-bot: ERROR https://docs.redwood.com/api/sdk#auth_token_refresh -> 404

miles: can we add a tiny compatibility layer in our docs renderer that maps underscore-preserving slugs to the normalized ones? or is redirect map the least-risky?

lia: redirect map again seems least risky. let's batch the top 25 fragments.

oz: I'll produce a CSV of changed headings and we can convert that to data/redirects.json. Also adding a short note to CONTRIBUTING.md about heading changes.

miles: also check the tutorial notebooks — some of them use permalinks with fragments inside code cells. those are easy to miss.

lia: agreed. adding a quick grep command to the docs repo docs/scripts/find-fragments.sh so folks can run it locally.

link-bot: note: rerun linkcheck after redirects added

oz: added first draft of redirects, opening #1523 for review.

lia: thanks. I'll triage the incoming bug reports and mark duplicates.

link-bot: linkcheck: PASS for commit 3c9f1ab

lia: awesome. follow-up: keep the redirect map in place for two weeks, then remove once we confirm no more hits. Also create dashboard metric for 404-to-redirect to measure cleanup progress.

oz: will do.
